title: 美银策略师：科技利好已被定价，市场面临调整
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I start with a large question and I imagine it involves a complex long answer and you'll have space for that. But why is the outlook for the index right now in your mind so compromised?
segments.zh: 我先问个大问题，答案可能很复杂，但您觉得为什么当前指数前景如此堪忧？

segments.en: Yeah, lots of different reasons. But one is what we've been talking about, what I've been listening to on the show so far. The good news for tech seems to be priced in. The companies are no longer rallying
segments.zh: 原因很多，但其中之一是科技股的利好似乎已被消化。这些公司不再因业绩和营收上涨而走强。

segments.en: and outperforming on beef, on earnings and revenues. In fact, they've sold off on earnings and revenues.
segments.zh: 实际上，它们在业绩和营收公布后反而下跌了。

segments.en: We've had an environment where the rest of the market is actually pretty healthy but I think it's all been obscured by the elephant in the room, which is mega-cap tech. And the idea that these
segments.zh: 市场其他部分其实相当健康，但都被科技巨头这头大象掩盖了。

segments.en: stocks are going to continue to lead us to new highs I think is no longer the case. Look, I like tech.
segments.zh: 认为这些权益资产会继续带领市场创新高的想法，我认为已不成立。我喜欢科技股。

segments.en: I think tech is the future. But I think right now we're in an air pocket and we've been talking about this all year. You know, the idea that we're in an environment where we know that chat,
segments.zh: 科技是未来，但现在我们处于一个真空期，全年都在讨论这个。

segments.en: you know, we know AI. We are bullish on AI. We know that companies are spending a ton of money.
segments.zh: 我们知道AI，看好AI，公司也在大量投入。

segments.en: ISM is above 50, well above 50. You know, CAPEX is strong. The economy is strong. Inflation is
segments.zh: ISM指数高于50，资本支出强劲，经济强劲，通胀也相当健康，甚至有点过热。

segments.en: pretty healthy, maybe even overheating a little bit. But the idea that we're going to see that same leadership from the ballast of the market, I just think is very hard to paint. On top of that,
segments.zh: 但认为市场基石会继续领涨，我认为很难实现。

segments.en: you've got an environment where the consumer has been chugging along, defying all expectations,
segments.zh: 此外，消费者一直超预期地稳步前行。
